concerns.text: Task T004 (Generate salience‑manipulated stimulus variants) requires the moral‑intent wrapper provided by T015, but T015 is listed later in the plan. The producer (T015) must precede the consumer (T004) to satisfy the data‑flow dependency.

Task T015 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) but it creates a code artifact (`bert_moral_intent.py`) that is a hard dependency for T004. Because T004 cannot run correctly without the wrapper, T015 is not truly parallel‑safe and should be placed before any task that consumes it (i.e., before T004).
